result.detail: Open items for the tech lead and reviewers. (1) [req:AXIL-FORMAL] in the interface spec and the .sby listed in the microarchitecture verification plan are not delivered here, because this task's expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench only. The RTL carries the properties under `ifdef FORMAL so that a follow-up task can add a single-task 'mode prove' .sby. (2) The failure-path testbench axi4_lite_regs_tb_fail.v named in the microarchitecture plan was not produced. A second top module in the simulator source list could conflict with the single simulator.run top, so it needs its own task or run. (3) Neither file uses `timescale, which avoids Verilator TIMESCALEMOD errors from mixing modules with and without one. (4) The testbench expects tb-driven timing, so Verilator needs --timing or --binary. (5) I have no tool access, so nothing here is verified. The platform's lint.run, simulator.run and synth.run results are the evidence.
